newsitem.title: GERMANY: German motorway becomes abattoir as 28 cattle die.
newsitem.headline: German motorway becomes abattoir as 28 cattle die.

text.p: A north German motorway resembled a slaughterhouse on Wednesday as a traffic accident claimed 28 casualties -- all of them cattle.

Most of the cows were killed almost immediately when the truck carrying them skidded and overturned on the A2 motorway near Bad Nenndorf, police said. The rest were so badly injured they had to be put down on the spot. The driver was unharmed.
